scope: offline source code, portable schemas and aggregate local cache metadata; no patient records exported

sources.note: E-utilities does not expose a numbered global release; exact alleles are cached for 7 days.

sources.name: GenCC
sources.note: Assertions are individually versioned; no single numbered database release is published in the export.

sources.note: The date shown is the newest evaluation date in the imported snapshot.

sources.name: Orphadata

sources.name: gnomAD
sources.note: Constraint is retrieved per gene and cached locally for 30 days.

sources.name: gnomAD genomes
sources.note: Exact alleles are retrieved from the assembly-matched genomes dataset and cached locally. Absence is distinguished from missing data using locus coverage.

sources.name: NCBI Variation Services
sources.release: SPDI API v0 · fixed RefSeq assembly accessions
sources.note: Exact sequence alleles are projected and normalized on demand; successful and negative mappings are cached locally.

sources.name: PanelApp
sources.note: Each panel retains its own version; the date shown is the newest panel update in the catalogue.

sources.name: ACMG Secondary Findings
sources.note: Versioned snapshots are shipped with the application and do not require synchronization.
